decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1.	The proposed extensions, due to the size, scale and location, would not preserve or enhance the Thorney Hedge Conservation Area and will detract from the rear of the building. Accordingly, the proposal is contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and Policy 4B.8 (Respect Local Character and Communities) of the London Plan.

Condition : 2 - 2.	The proposed extensions and flat conversion will result in an unacceptable standard of accommodation for future occupants. The proposed flat does not meet the room sizes within the Supplementary Planning Guidance, not all rooms are usable in layout and the head height within the flat will not result in a desirable form of living accommodation. Accordingly, the proposal is not in accordance with the Supplementary Planning Guidance, Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines), H.4.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats) of the Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of four rear roof dormers and creation of one x two bedroom flat within roof space
